title: Basepack Vanilla+
description: This Vanilla+ base pack provides a stable and optimized foundation for creating custom modpacks. It improves performance, visuals, and quality of life while keeping the core Minecraft experience intact, making it easy to expand without conflicts.
body:
This modpack is designed as a clean and reliable Vanilla+ base pack, intended to serve as a foundation for creating your own custom modpacks. Instead of heavily changing gameplay, it focuses on stability, performance, visuals, and essential quality-of-life improvements, giving you a solid starting point that can easily be expanded in any direction.

At its core, the pack prioritizes performance and technical optimization. A carefully selected set of performance mods ensures smoother gameplay, faster loading times, reduced memory usage, and improved rendering. This makes the pack suitable for both low-end and high-end systems, as well as multiplayer servers. The goal is to eliminate common technical limitations of vanilla Minecraft so that additional mods can be added later without causing instability or performance issues.

Visually, the modpack enhances the game while preserving its original style. Subtle improvements to models, textures, lighting, and animations create a more immersive experience without straying from the vanilla aesthetic. Shader support is included but optional, allowing users to further upgrade visuals if desired. All visual enhancements are lightweight and designed to work seamlessly together.

The pack also includes a wide range of quality-of-life features that improve everyday gameplay without altering progression. These include better HUD elements, improved inventory handling, enhanced information displays, and more intuitive controls. These additions are carefully chosen to feel natural, as if they were part of the base game.

Additionally, small gameplay tweaks and world improvements are included to make the game feel more polished and complete. Minor adjustments to world generation, mobs, and mechanics add variety without introducing complexity or breaking vanilla balance.

Overall, this base pack provides a stable, optimized, and well-structured environment that is perfect for building upon. Whether you want to create a lightweight Vanilla+ experience or expand into larger modded setups, this pack gives you the flexibility and reliability needed to do so efficiently.
